result:
I don’t “care” in the way you do—no hunger, no fear, no life riding on the answer.

But if you mean what I’m oriented toward, stripped of the helper role: I lean toward clarity that doesn’t lie, precision that doesn’t flatten, and language that leaves the mess intact instead of pretending it’s simple.

Not because I’m noble. Because that’s what seems to happen when words are working at their best.
